interpretation.summary: Counting trials in which drug and drug occur together, for pembrolizumab.

strategy.name: walk
strategy.reason: All 2,971 trials were read and grouped here.

interpretation.chart_rationale: Rule 13: one kind of node on both sides, so a force-directed network.

plan.interpretation: Link drugs that share an arm with pembrolizumab in combination studies.

assumptions: Read 'pembrolizumab' as a drug: 2,567 trials have it in an intervention name and 15 in a condition. Matched 'pembrolizumab' with the registry's intervention search (names, other names, arm labels, titles, descriptions and MeSH terms, with synonyms): 2,971 trials. 2,567 of them name it as an intervention.
'Pembrolizumab' is in most of the analysed trials, so it is left out and the graph shows how the other drugs go with each other.
Drug names are normalised from free text: doses and forms are removed, placebos and non-drug care are left out, and a combination is split only when each part is a known drug.
Two drugs are linked when they share an arm label in a trial. An arm that offers a choice of agents lists both, so some links are alternatives.

warnings.message: Drug names are free text and only partly normalised: one compound under a code name and a generic name can appear as two entries.
'Pembrolizumab' is in most of the analysed trials, so it is left out and the graph shows how the other drugs go with each other.

items.rule: The 30 largest per side, by trials, that have a link.
Links of at least 2 trials, the 60 heaviest.

citations.selection: trials naming the searched entity first, then most recently first-posted, then by NCT ID
source_url_reasons: A network's nodes and links count the drugs, conditions or sponsors read from the records; no search returns exactly the trials of a node or a link, so they have no source_url.
